turns.client: I mean, it’s just that I try to play my part, but then I get anxious and second-guess myself. It makes it hard to focus on what everyone else is doing. I guess it’s just how it goes sometimes, right?

turns.client: I just feel like I start to lose track of what I'm supposed to be doing. It’s almost like I freeze up, and then I feel like I'm holding everyone back. But I mean, everyone has their off days, right? It's not that big of a deal.

turns.therapist: Freezing up and feeling like you're holding everyone back can be a tough experience, especially in a group setting. When you notice yourself feeling this way, what do you think happens to your thoughts or your body sensations in those moments?
turns.client: I guess my mind gets really jumbled, and I can feel my heart racing. It’s just part of the nerves, I think. I’ve seen other people have their moments too, so I try not to overthink it. It's just how it goes sometimes, you know?
